'''July 2001 Springfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Wizards of the Coast store, Springfield Mall, Springfield, VA in July 2001. [[Michael Sorrell]] won it. It is known from Michael Sorrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2759">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-wotc-is-good-for-something-vad2759/ wotc-is-good-for-something-va], DeckTech (Michael "choker" Sorrell, 1 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-wotc-is-good-for-something-vad2759/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' July 2001
* '''Site:''' Wizards of the Coast store, Springfield Mall, Springfield, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Sorrell]]
